description:
Remove stale active instructions left by previous SCR SDLC and copied project configuration. Correct .claude/skills/lets-scr/SKILL.md: it advertises nonexistent stack/web/database commands and retired sdlc tasks/briefs/stack/maintree groups. Remove instructions in .codex/agents/swe.toml and verifier.toml that direct writes to /home/fudya/devel/physical/mitme/.codex/agent-memory/; use SCR-local instructions and retain role purpose. Audit stale CLAUDE.md references and automatic transcript/hook claims against actual Codex capabilities. Correct obsolete registry comments and duplicate ignore rules only where proven stale; retain ignore coverage. Acceptance: live guidance uses real LETS commands, SCR-local paths, current SDLC ceremonies, and accurate attribution claims. Preserve optional Claude tooling, active protection hooks, legitimate general skills, Codex configuration, historical snapshots, and model configuration. Independent of ITM-0001; no module, image, package, hardware, or external-repository operations.

Migration readiness extends role/config audit to actual available Codex worker/model routing and maintained effort mappings. Current etc/sdlc.conf advertises gpt-5.6-sol/gpt-5.6-terra aliases absent from this session's available model list. Keep deliberate supported choices; supersede blanket model-configuration preservation where it would retain unsupported aliases. Select concrete supported settings during independent item planning, retain full role handoffs/fallback semantics and real worker concurrency limits, and verify configured independent roles can launch through current tools. Do not introduce Claude runtime dependency or claim automatic transcript capture. ITM-0006 consumes this verified instruction/role-routing result in final readiness; no module compilation or device authority granted.
